note: Ps67 missionary-harvest blessing (corrected; short, God-blessing framed). Human IB: the universal KNOWING (yada) of God's way on earth; the fourfold refrain PRAISE (yadah x4); the nations GLAD (samach) + SING FOR JOY (ranan); the closing FEAR (yare) of all the ends of the earth. God-qualifiers=9 (gracious/bless x3/shine/saving-power/judge/equity/guide) - the blessing framed so God's way be known and all peoples praise. Earth's yield/increase = standalone. Every candidate roled.

dims.v: know / be known (yada - that your way may be known)
the purpose of God's gracious blessing (v1)

'that your WAY may be KNOWN (yada) on earth, your saving power among all nations' — the missionary purpose of God's blessing; yada here the earth coming to know God's way and salvation - the blessing on 'us' aimed outward, that all nations may know him (the qualifiers gracious/bless framing it)
praise / give thanks (yadah - let the peoples praise you)

'Let the peoples PRAISE (yadah) you, O God' — the refrain that is the psalm's heartbeat; yadah here the praise the psalmist longs for all peoples to give - not Israel alone but the nations, worship as the fruit of God's way being known
praise / give thanks (yadah - let all the peoples praise you)
the emphatic doubling of the refrain

'let ALL the peoples PRAISE (yadah) you!' — the universal reach of the refrain; yadah here the praise of every people without exception - the psalm's longing that no nation be left out of the worship of God
be glad / rejoice (samach - let the nations be glad)
because God judges the peoples with equity and guides them (v4)

'Let the nations be GLAD (samach) and sing for joy, for you judge the peoples with equity' — gladness grounded in God's just rule; samach here the joy of the nations that God governs the earth rightly (the qualifiers judge/equity/guide) - good news that God's justice is for all peoples, not against them
sing for joy / ring out (ranan - and sing for joy)
'and SING FOR JOY (ranan)' — the jubilant song of the nations at God's just rule; ranan here the ringing joy that answers the gladness - worship overflowing in song from all peoples
praise / give thanks (yadah - let the peoples praise you)

'Let the peoples PRAISE (yadah) you, O God' — the refrain returning, framing the psalm's centre; yadah here the praise-refrain repeated so that all the peoples' worship brackets the vision of God's just rule over the nations
praise / give thanks (yadah - let all the peoples praise you)
the emphatic doubling of the refrain
'let ALL the peoples PRAISE (yadah) you!' — the universal refrain repeated; yadah here the praise of every people, the psalm's fourfold cry that the whole earth join in worship
fear / revere (yare - let all the ends of the earth fear him)
all the ends of the earth

'God shall bless us; let all the ends of the earth FEAR (yare) him!' — reverent fear as the psalm's closing goal; yare here the awe of the whole earth, drawn by God's blessing (the qualifier) - the harvest and the blessing meant to turn the ends of the earth to fear and worship God
be gracious (chanan - may God be gracious to us)
God's grace, aimed at his way being known (v1->v2)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's grace): 'May God be GRACIOUS (chanan) to us and bless us' - God's graciousness is not a human IB char; the blessing sought so his way may be known on earth (306501). Qualifier.
God's blessing, aimed at his way being known (v1->v2)
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'and BLESS (barak) us' - God's blessing is not a human IB char; the favour sought so that his way be known among all nations (306501). Qualifier.
shine / give light (or - make his face to shine upon us)
God's shining face, aimed at his way being known (v1->v2)

v1 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'and make his face to SHINE (or) upon us' - God's shining face (the Aaronic blessing) is not a human IB char; the favour that lights the way for all nations to know him (306501). Qualifier.
salvation / saving power (yeshuah - your saving power among all nations)
God's saving power, made known among all nations (v2)

v2 QUALIFIER (God's salvation): 'your SAVING POWER (yeshuah) among all nations' - God's salvation is not a human IB char; the object of the earth's knowing (306501), his deliverance made known to all peoples. Qualifier.
judge (shaphat - you judge the peoples with equity)
God judges the peoples with equity, ground of the nations' gladness (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'for you JUDGE (shaphat) the peoples with equity' - God's judging is not a human IB char; the just rule that grounds the nations' gladness (281409). Qualifier.
God's equity in judging, ground of the nations' gladness (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's equity): 'you judge the peoples with EQUITY (mishor)' - God's fairness is not a human IB char; the uprightness of his rule that makes the nations glad (281409). Qualifier.
guide / lead (nachah - guide the nations upon earth)
God guides the nations, ground of their gladness (v4)
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'and GUIDE (nachah) the nations upon earth' - God's guiding is not a human IB char; his shepherding of the peoples that grounds their gladness (281409). Qualifier.
bless (barak - God, our God, shall bless us)
God's blessing, meant to draw the earth to fear him (v6->v7)

v6 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'God, our God, shall BLESS (barak) us' - God's blessing is not a human IB char; the favour, seen in the earth's yield, that turns the ends of the earth to fear him (281437). Qualifier.
God's blessing, meant to draw the earth to fear him (v7)

v7 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'God shall BLESS (barak) us' - God's blessing is not a human IB char; the repeated favour that grounds the closing call for all the ends of the earth to fear him (281437). Qualifier.
way / path (derek - that your way may be known)

v2: 'that your WAY (derek) may be known on earth' - God's way/character, the object of the earth's knowing (the char, 306501); God's revealed manner of acting. Standalone (God's way, the object known).
give / yield (natan - the earth has yielded its increase)
v6: 'The earth has YIELDED (natan) its increase' - the harvest as sign of God's blessing; the earth's produce, a creation-provision, not a human inner operation. Standalone (the harvest yield).
v6: 'the earth has yielded its INCREASE (yebul)' - the crop the land produces as the token of God's blessing; a creation-provision. Standalone (the harvest produce).
